name: 道の駅 くるめ
desc: 福岡県久留米市の国道210号沿いにある道の駅「くるめ」。美しい耳納連山の麓に位置し、豊かな自然に囲まれています。最大の特徴は、農業都市・久留米ならではの品揃えを誇る直売所です。特産品は、地元農家から毎朝届く新鮮な野菜や、ぶどう、柿、いちごなどの旬のフルーツ。手作りのお弁当や惣菜も人気を集めています。隣接する「くるめ緑花センター」とともに、久留米の豊かな大地の恵みを存分に堪能できるスポットです。
descEn: Located along Route 210 in Kurume City, Fukuoka Prefecture, Roadside Station "Kurume" is situated at the foot of the beautiful Mino mountain range, surrounded by abundant nature. Its greatest feature is the farmers' market, which boasts a vast selection unique to Kurume, a major agricultural city. Local specialties include fresh vegetables delivered every morning by local farmers, as well as seasonal fruits like grapes, persimmons, and strawberries. Handmade bento boxes and deli items are also highly popular. Together with the adjacent "Kurume Ryokka Center" (plant and flower center), it is a wonderful spot where you can fully enjoy the rich earthly blessings of Kurume.
